svg.title: Claymark adaptive icon — foreground layer
svg.desc: 108x108dp canvas, transparent background, the "C" scaled by 108/512 = 0.2109375 from icon-c.svg's coordinates and re-centered — not re-eyeballed at this size. Outer radius 31.64dp sits inside the 33dp (66dp diameter / 2) safe-zone radius confirmed by the platform spec, with margin to spare, so no OEM launcher mask shape clips it.
